quest.title: Contraption-Contrived Cooking Course: Part III
quest.description: Cloud Retainer is preparing to use the "Supreme Cuisine Machine" to make three all-new dishes...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000, Recipe: Braised Meat x1

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One shall entrust the heat control to you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The azure trees stand tall amid the snowy scene, the land is lonely and tranquil. Verily does one's third dish suit this atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of dish are you going to make this time?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Well. Have you ever heard tell of a method known as "braising"? This technique did one discover upon reading through some culinary tomes.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: A fancy did one take to it, and thus created a new recipe, "Braised Meat," with this culinary technique as its heart.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Now, this dish is hardly too tall a task for one's Supreme Cuisine Machine, but meat is key to this dish, and none but the best shall one have.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Thus did one activate a mechanism and pursue the scent of fine ingredients to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The snow and wind drive hard here, and makes for slow work.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One is aware, Traveler, of your wealth of adventuring experience. Surely, then, a mere snowy mountain will prove no obstacle to you.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One thus requests that you go forthwith and retrieve some ingredients once more.

choices.text: I'd like to have the recipe for this third dish, too.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Your aid shall not be forgotten. For the completion of this errand shall one await you here.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmm. The mechanism has come to a halt. 'Tis must be the biting cold.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Allow one to restart it...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: This should resolve the issue. Now then, Traveler, pursue the scent one has put you on and retrieve those ingredients.

choices.text: Too cold to fly, are we?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Nonsense! How daring of you, to gainsay one's adeptal might! One is merely... occupied repairing these devices!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Depart now. One grows impatient.

talks.objective: Follow the aura trail and find the ingredients

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: How goes your search? Secured the ingredients one desires, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Well? Is the Braised Meat complete?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: ...What manner of morsel is this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They call it Chilled Meat.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Chilled Meat... An apt name indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: It is of fair quality, too. Still, we shall need a small fire to thaw it out.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Fortunately, defrosting counts among the Supreme Cuisine Machine's functions.

choices.text: It sure seems to have no shortage of functions, huh.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ah! Falsehoods. This device does not lack for missing functions. The ability to automatically gather ingredients, for one. Or automatic heat control, for that matter... one could go on.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Many improvements still must one make to it in the coming days.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: We shall cease the idle talk there. The ingredients are prepared, one shall activate this device immediately.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The heat control shall still be left in your hands, Traveler.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One would have you report your readiness once you are sufficiently prepared.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One would prefer that you saved that praise for the Supreme Cuisine Machine's faculties.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep, I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Then let us begin.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Supreme Cuisine Machine... activate!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmm. Ready yourself, then, and inform one once it is so.

talks.objective: Help Cloud Retainer complete the dish

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One could not call the heat control desirable...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Mmm... A most wonderful flavor. One would have expected no less...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: 'Tis so. The completion of these three dishes has proven the reliability of one's Supreme Cuisine Machine.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: We have but to solve the two issues of heat control and the automatic retrieval of ingredients, and this machine shall truly have achieved "all-in-one cooking."

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ah, yes, lest one forgets... Your Braised Meat recipe. With but one difference — this recipe involves the use of normal Raw Meat instead.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One deems that it might be inconvenient for you to scale this frigid mountain each time you wish to eat this meal...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ordinary meat shall serve in ordinary occasions.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Regardless, you have one's thanks for your aid in foraging for ingredients.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: To one's abode one must now return, and make further improvements to this device. Let us part here, then.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Should one require any further succor... perhaps one shall call upon you again.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: A measure of faith one has that you shall not decline should that time come. Most highly does one regard your abilities and trustworthiness, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Now then, Traveler, pursue the scent one has put you on and retrieve the ingredients one requires.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Are you fully prepared, Traveler?
